pages.text: This pack is full of building mods. Use them; nobody else will.
$(bold)Chipped$(): a set of workbenches that turn any block into dozens of variants. One per material type.
$(bold)Handcrafted$() and $(bold)Another Furniture$(): chairs, tables, beds, shelves, counters.

$(bold)Supplementaries$() and $(bold)Amendments$(): jars, sacks, signposts, flags, globes, item shelves, ropes.$(br2)Also Twigs, Decorative Blocks, Stoneworks, Diagonal Fences and Walls, Vertical Slabs, Quark, Toni's Lanterns, Hearths, Gallery and Multi-Piston.
